# PiTTy v0.6.3 — truthful compaction telemetry and transcript-first scrolling

This release adds factual live compaction metadata and makes expanded tool output and diffs stop trapping ordinary conversation scrolling.

## Truthful compaction telemetry

PiTTy now uses a small bundled observer extension to report lifecycle metadata from Pi's native compaction. The observer returns no compaction result and never replaces or cancels Pi's implementation.

The active tab can show, when provided by Pi:

- compaction reason and elapsed time;
- pre-compaction context size;
- messages selected for summarization;
- planned and authoritative retained context-message counts; and
- factual before/after token counts on completion.

Unknown values remain unknown. No completion percentage, denominator, or ETA is fabricated. Telemetry is versioned, strictly validated, ephemeral, and isolated to its owning tab; delayed status from an older attempt cannot overwrite a newer one.

## Transcript-first expanded output

Expanded tool output and diffs now leave normal wheel input with the conversation. A visible `scroll output` or `scroll diff` action explicitly activates inner scrolling, while `chat scroll` releases it. Collapse remains beside those controls in the same header area.

Non-expandable output and existing thinking behavior remain unchanged. Tab-safe scroll restoration and tool-call correlation also received regression fixes for concurrent calls, mixed known and unknown IDs, repeated prompts, and tab switches.
